
# ============================================================
# Differential Gene Expression Analysis with DESeq2
# ============================================================

#required libraries

```{r}

library(DESeq2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(writexl)
library(enrichR)


```

# import gene counts table

```{r, generate variables}

sample_names    <- c("sample1", "sample2", "sample3", "sample4")
conditions      <- c("control", "control", "treatment", "treatment")
reference_level <- "control" 

counts_file     <- "counts.tab"          # path to raw counts table
annotation_file <- "genes.bed"           # path to gene annotation BED file
output_dir      <- "outputs"             # output directory

annotation_cols <- c("chr", "start", "strand", "end",
                     "symbol", "ensembl_gene_id", "description")

condition_colors <- c("control"   = "sandybrown",
                      "treatment" = "olivedrab3")

# create output directories

dir.create(file.path(output_dir, "plots"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(output_dir, "files"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

```

```{r, import and annotate counts}

# import gene counts
gene_counts <- read.table(counts_file,
                          sep       = "\t",
                          col.names = sample_names,
                          skip      = skip_lines)

gene_counts$ensembl_gene_id <- rownames(gene_counts)
gene_counts$ensembl_gene_id <- gsub("\\..*","", gene_counts$ensembl_gene_id)

# annotate with gene symbol

annotation <- read.table(annotation_file,
                         sep       = "\t",
                         header    = FALSE,
                         col.names = annotation_cols)

gene_counts <- merge(gene_counts, annotation, by = "ensembl_gene_id")

# remove duplicates

gene_counts_unique <- gene_counts %>%
  group_by(symbol) %>%
  slice_max(.data[[sample_names[1]]], with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

gene_counts_unique$symbol <- make.unique(gene_counts_unique$symbol)

# Set the modified gene symbols as row names
rownames(gene_counts_unique) <- gene_counts_unique$symbol

# Convert to data frame, then set row names
gene_counts_unique <- as.data.frame(gene_counts_unique)
rownames(gene_counts_unique) <- gene_counts_unique$symbol


```


# BUILD DESEQ2 OBJECT

```{r}

sample_info <- data.frame(row.names = sample_names,
                          condition = factor(conditions))

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = count_cols,
                              colData   = sample_info,
                              design    = ~ condition)

# Pre-filter low-count genes
dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds)) > 5, ]

# Set reference level
dds$condition <- relevel(dds$condition, ref = reference_level)

```

# PCA

```{r}

dds_vst <- vst(dds)
pca_data <- plotPCA(dds_vst, intgroup = "condition", returnData = TRUE)

pca_plot <- ggplot(pca_data, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2,
                                  fill  = condition,
                                  label = name)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 1.3, size = 4) +
  geom_text_repel(size = 4, max.overlaps = 20) +
  labs(title = "PCA") +
  xlab(pc1_variance) +
  ylab(pc2_variance) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = condition_colors) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid      = element_blank(),
        axis.title      = element_text(size = 15),
        plot.title      = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        legend.title    = element_blank())

pdf(file.path(output_dir, "plots", "PCA.pdf"), width = 8, height = 7)
print(pca_plot)
dev.off()

```

# differential expression results

```{r, results}

# calculate results
dds <- DESeq(dds)
results <- results(dds)

# make dataframe
df_results <- merge(as.data.frame(results),
                     as.data.frame(counts(dds, normalized=TRUE)),
                     by="row.names", sort=FALSE)
df_results <-na.omit(df_results)

# annotate dge status
df_results <-mutate(df_results, 
                    direction = ifelse(log2FoldChange>0, "up","down"), 
                    stat_diff = ifelse(padj<0.01, "signf", "no_signf"),
                    bio_diff = ifelse(abs(log2FoldChange)>1, "relevant","irrelevant"), 
                    diff_group = paste(direction, stat_diff, bio_diff))

df_results$diffexpressed <- "NO"
df_results$diffexpressed[df_results$log2FoldChange > 1 & df_results$pvalue < 0.05] <- "UP" 
df_result$diffexpressed[df_results$log2FoldChange < -1 & df_results$pvalue < 0.05] <- "DOWN"

# show results
summary(resultsdds)
resultsdds

# export results
comparison_label <- paste0(
  unique(conditions[conditions != reference_level]), "_vs_", reference_level
)

write_xlsx(df_results, file.path(output_dir, "files", paste0("DGE_", comparison_label, ".xlsx")))

```

# Volcano plot 

```{r, create function}

volcano_ptch <- function(df,
                        gene_column = gene_column,
                        colors = colors,
                        number_genes = number_genes,
                        title = title) {
  gene_column <- as.character(gene_column)
  df$log2FoldChange <- as.numeric(as.character(df$log2FoldChange))
  df$pvalue <- as.numeric(as.character(df$pvalue))

  # Remove rows with missing values
  df <- df[!is.na(df$pvalue) & !is.na(df$log2FoldChange), ]

  df$delabel <- NA

  top_genes <- head(df[order(df$pvalue), gene_column], number_genes)
  df$delabel <- ifelse(df[[gene_column]] %in% top_genes, df[[gene_column]], NA)

  title <- title

  ggplot(data=df, aes(x=log2FoldChange, y=-log10(pvalue), col=diffexpressed, label=delabel)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_text_repel(show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Log2 Fold Change", y = "-Log10 P-value") +
    geom_vline(xintercept=c(-1, 1), col="black", linetype = 'dashed') +
    theme_classic() +
    geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(0.05), col="black", linetype = 'dashed') +
    ggtitle(title)
}

```

```{r, plot results}

pdf(file.path(output_dir, "plots", paste0("Volcano_", comparison_label, ".pdf")), width = 10, height = 8)
volcano_ptch(df_results, "peak", c("blue", "grey", "red"), 5, "Volcano Plot of Differentially Accessible Peaks" ) + theme_classic()
dev.off()


```






# GO analysis

```{r, GO function}

run_enrichr_go_BP <- function(genes) {
  library(enrichR)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  

  dbs <- c(
    #"GO_Molecular_Function_2025",
    #                               "GO_Cellular_Component_2025",
                                   "GO_Biological_Process_2025" #,
    #                               "WikiPathway_2025_Human",
    #                               "GWAS_Catalog_2025"
    )
  

  enriched <- enrichr(as.vector(genes), dbs)
  df <- enriched[[1]]
  
  colnames(df) <- gsub("GO_Biological_Process_2025\\.", "", colnames(df))

  if ("Overlap" %in% colnames(df)) {
    df <- df %>%
      separate(col = "Overlap", into = c("Gene_count", "total"), sep = "/") %>%
      mutate(Gene_count = as.numeric(Gene_count),
             total = as.numeric(total),
             gene_ratio = Gene_count / total)
  }
  
  return(df)
}

plot_enrichr_df <- function(df, top_n = 20,
                             plot_title = "Gene Ontology Enrichment") {
  library(ggplot2)
  
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
    warning("empty df")
    return(NULL)
  }

  
  ggplot(head(df, n = top_n), aes(x = Term, y = -log10(P.value))) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "azure4", size = 0.5) +
    geom_point(aes(size = Gene_count, colour = gene_ratio), alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = rev(head(df$Term, n = top_n))) +
    scale_color_gradient(low = "green", high = "red", limits = c(0, NA)) +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.ticks.length = unit(-0.1, "cm"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(margin = margin(5, 5, 0, 5, "pt"), size = 14),
      axis.text.y = element_text(margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5, "pt"), size = 12),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.title.align = 0.5,
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")
    ) +
    xlab("GO Terms") +
    ylab("-log10(P.value)") +
    labs(color = "Gene Ratio", size = "Number\nof genes") +
    ggtitle(plot_title)

}


```

```{r, generate GO results}

library(enrichR)

# select DGE genes
dge_up <- subset(df_results_EP1vsAro, diffexpressed == "UP")
dge_down <- subset(df_results_EP1vsAro, diffexpressed == "DOWN")

#create df
GOup_df <- createdfforGO_ptch(as.vector(dge_up$Row.names))
GOdown_df <- createdfforGO_ptch(as.vector(dge_down$Row.names))

# export enrichment results
write_xlsx(GO_up_df,
           file.path(output_dir, "files", paste0("GO_UP_", comparison_label, ".xlsx")))
write_xlsx(GO_down_df,
           file.path(output_dir, "files", paste0("GO_DOWN_", comparison_label, ".xlsx")))

pdf(file.path(output_dir, "plots", paste0("GO_", comparison_label, ".pdf")), width = 13, height = 10)

createPLOTGO_ptch(GOdown_df, paste0("GO_BP: ", comparison_label, " DOWN"))
dev.off()
                                                   
```
